description: System OpenGL ICD on Zink (WGL): the gallium wgl target DLL renamed amdgpu_wddm_gl.dll, which the display adapter's driver key names in OpenGLDriverName and OpenGLDriverNameWow, no LLVM. The zink-gl set plus -Db_ndebug=true (no live assert in a DLL that loads into every OpenGL application), -Db_vscrt=mt (the same reason the radv-mt set takes it: an application that ships its own msvcp140.dll hands it to every DLL that imports that name) and -Dgallium-wgl-dll-name=amdgpu_wddm_gl. buildtype stays debugoptimized, as in every shipped Mesa component of this project: /O2 with NDEBUG and a PDB

source.note: worktree_diff_sha256 is the SHA-256 of "git diff --binary HEAD" (tracked files only)
